Overview.Name: Alukanti Deepika
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed, avoids non-veg on Monday and Saturday

Meal_1 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2–3 eggs) & vegetable curry + curd
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Meal_2 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber salad
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup ~150 g) & paneer cubes (120 g) + vegetable curry

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid non-veg on Monday and Saturday and follow vegetarian options.
Start meals with eggs or paneer before eating rice.
Maintain consistent meal timing to support thyroid health.
Keep dinner light to improve fat loss and energy.
During social gatherings, eat your regular meal first to avoid overeating.
